messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — PagerDuty: P1 synthetic-checks: apac-canary probe loss > 60% across probe fleet. Triggered 4 minutes ago. Link: https://pd.redwood.com/incidents/INC-98765 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Incident INC-98765 assigned to on-call schedule 'sre-tilly' (Tilly). Auto-escalation in 10m if unacked.
Lina Chen: saw the PD alert, looking now. which region is primary?
Derek Patel: apac-canary node group — probes from 3 AZs failing health checks, all returning 502. Seeing similar from internal synthetic runner.
Jae Park: confirming telemetry: probe-loss spike started @ 2026-03-15T02:12Z, error rate jumped from 1% -> 63% over 2m.
Tilly (Ops Oncall): acked on PD. I'm on it, popping into the prober logs now.
SRE Rotation Bot: Reminder: runbook 'synth-probes-failure' suggested steps: 1) check prober runners, 2) validate endpoint TLS certs, 3) check routing table.
Lina Chen: quick check — are we seeing any customer-facing errors? any user reports?
Derek Patel: no customer 5xx alerts yet in the API gateway; most traffic is served by eu/us edges. However some customers routed to apac might see elevated latencies or degraded LLM responses.
Tilly (Ops Oncall): log tail from prober runner 12: ```
[02:12:31] prober: request to canary-eu1 returned 502
[02:12:31] prober: downstream conn reset by peer
[02:12:33] prober: repeated 502s across targets
[02:12:34] prober: retrying, backend tcp handshake timeout
```
Jae Park: inter-service traces show last hop failing: load-balancer -> inference-router TCP resets. Could be network flapping in apac1 cluster.
pagerduty: INC-98765 escalated to Derek after 8 minutes (no resolution).
Derek Patel: I'm SSHing into the apac1 lb control plane to check BGP/peering. Can someone flag any recent deploys?
Lina Chen: no infra deploys in apac in the last hour. Deployment dashboard shows none.
Tilly (Ops Oncall): I see a config change 30m ago on the autoscaler for apac routing weights — that was a no-op, but worth checking. Rollback button available.
Jae Park: running quick network health checks: ```
$ curl -v https://apac1-lb.healthcheck.internal/status
* Connected to apac1-lb (10.200.1.5) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake: server cert ok
* recv() failed: Connection reset by peer
```
Lina Chen: interesting that TLS is OK but the TCP resets. Could be backend process crash or kernel OOM on the router.
Tilly (Ops Oncall): I've put a temporary routing fallback: routing policy switched to 'apac-fallback-1' to route traffic to apac2. Applying now — expect partial mitigation within ~30s. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
incident-bot: NOTE — automated fallback policy applied to apac cluster by Tilly. Fallback target: apac2.
SRE Rotation Bot: Add check: observe synthetic success rate post-fallback for 10 minutes before closing.
Derek Patel: verifying prober after fallback: prober success rate climbed from 37% -> 92% within 45s. Good sign.
pagerduty: INC-98765 comment added by Tilly: "applied routing fallback to apac2; monitoring. will escalate to network team if reoccurs."
Jae Park: traces show router connections stabilizing, but we still have 2 nodes in apac1 with repeated resets. Opening ticket to network infra: NET-54321.
Lina Chen: can we confirm customer impact window so we can notify support?
Tilly (Ops Oncall): timeline so far: 02:12Z start of prober failures; 02:20Z routing fallback applied; 02:21Z large majority of probes recovered. Impact window ~ 8–9 minutes for apac-routed customers.
Derek Patel: mitigation steps: 1) keep fallback for 1h, 2) cordon problematic apac1 routers and drain, 3) network team to investigate BGP/peer flaps, 4) follow-up postmortem.
Lina Chen: noted — I'll draft an internal customer-impact note: "Short-lived probe failures in apac cluster caused brief elevated latency and degraded model responses for apac-routed traffic between 02:12–02:21Z. No broad user-facing outage; mitigation applied automatically and traffic routed to fallback region."
Tilly (Ops Oncall): acking on PD and adding timeline to incident. I'll hand off to Derek for network investigation. If anything spikes, re-pager.
Derek Patel: taking ownership for the follow-up (NET-54321). Will coordinate with network on-call and postmortem.
pagerduty: Incident INC-98765 status: Acknowledged by Tilly (Ops Oncall). Next escalation disabled while assigned.
Lina Chen: thanks all. Quick follow-up Qs: please collect pcap from failing router and set retention to 24h for NET-54321.
Jae Park: started pcap capture command on apac1-router-7, saving to /var/tmp/netcaps/NET-54321.pcap.
SRE Rotation Bot: Checklist updated: mitigation recorded, fallback applied, oncall handoff complete. Close incident after network confirms root cause and postmortem is scheduled.
incident-bot: Incident thread closed for now — monitoring period active. :white_check_mark:
